# GitHub pull requests are not accepted

Repository Standards uses GitHub as a generated public distribution. Forgejo is the single canonical source of truth.

**Please do not submit this pull request. It will not be reviewed or merged.**

Instead, open the appropriate GitHub Issue:

- Bug Report
- Standard Change Proposal
- Documentation Proposal

Accepted proposals are evaluated, implemented, reviewed, and qualified in the canonical Forgejo repository. A later deterministic Public Core publication then updates GitHub.

See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for the full process.
